reason: Both predicted windows are flat continuum: D1 at 5880.7 Å (samples 2800-2803, flux ~6.1, ivar ~57) and D2 at 5886.7 Å (samples 2808-2810, flux ~5.8-6.2, ivar ~60) show no absorption dip.
